title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(菅野圭祐研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Sugano Keisuke)
educationalGoal: The purpose of learning and education is to take various actions to change the region, through being involved in the local life to be studied, organize the responses obtained using qualitative analysis, and cultivate the ability to link to concrete architectural and urban designs. This series of research processes is logically planned, designed, and executed, and the results are compiled into a research paper or design work.
advice: Project Design Ⅲ emphasizes developing students' own knowledge and abilities to plan and execute projects through their own independent actions. For this reason, they will generally work on the following activities, assuming their own interests in cities, regions, and society. 1) Clarification of concerns about cities / regions and society (information collecting and discussion) 2) Systematic understanding of the factors surrounding the problem (information collecting and problem structuring) [Review of existing studies, review of literature / Field survey (case studies of related cases, excellent cases, etc.)] 3) Setting project theme [Theme setting / target area setting / planning of project execution (setting of analysis method)] 4) Project implementation and coordination [Case study and analysis / Visualization and structuring of analysis results, (if necessary) designing / result presentation (mid review committee (December), public presentation review committee)]
requiredKnowledge: ・ Being interested in daily phenomena related to urban space, society and landscape. ・ Visiting to various cities and regions. ・ Having a willingness to go deeper and explore their interests, or continue their efforts.

activityGoals.body: Collecting information in accordance with their own interests and explain the positioning of the problem.
Appropriate research methods can be set and executed according to the purpose of the project theme.
Research and analysis results can be expressed in appropriate way.
A series of processes from problem setting to survey analysis and their results can be logically expressed.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students can collect necessary information according to thire own interests, such as related literature surveys and field surveys, and can systematically explain the positioning of problems in the relevant field and the necessity of solving them. Students can think and set an appropriate framework and method for research and analysis appropriate to the purpose of the project (solution of the problem), and promote the project systematically and effectively. The results obtained can be logically compiled and communicated to others effectively and clearly.
achievementLevels.standard: Students can gather and explain necessary information, such as related literature surveys and site survey, concerning their own interests. Students can set an appropriate method according to the purpose of the project (solve the problem) and carry out the project. Students can summarize and explain the results obtained.
